rules.subject: Named imports and re-exports use the imported name (before any alias); default and namespace imports use the local identifier; side-effect imports, export * forms and dynamic imports use the quoted module literal, normalizing double quotes to single quotes.
The raw JSX tag name, or input[type=checkbox] / input[type=radio] for a statically typed input.
The complete arbitrary-value class token including variants and important marker, or an arbitrary CSS property token.
The complete class token (including variants, important marker and opacity), or attribute=value for a literal SVG color.
The complete statically readable class token, including unknown variants, important markers and opacity modifiers. Bases after valid variants are not checked.

The unquoted property name; a flattened expression for conditional, logical, array, template and other unreadable styles; a callee followed by (); a spread prefixed with three dots; [computed]; style for a string attribute; or `<style>` for a style element. Subjects omit whitespace and source positions.

Glued template edges replace interpolations with ${…}; the joined subject depends on the chunk around the final interpolation (text-${b} w-[${a}px] joins w-[${…}px], but w-[${a}px] ${b} has separate edges). Unreadable design-component values use the JSX tag and a flattened identifier, member or callee with empty parentheses. Direct calls omit arguments; member expressions over calls retain flattened arguments (getA(1).b). Subjects omit source positions.
